messages:
Sarah (CS): Hi all, opening VegaCo onboarding thread. Goal: have the hosted API integrated and a go/no-go readiness checklist by day 10, and a handoff doc for Vega infra by day 30.
Mike S.: Sounds good. Do we already have contacts and staging keys?
Sarah (CS): Jenna (platform), Omar (security), Luis (product) are the main contacts. Staging keys are live; prod keys need SSO and contract sign-off.
Raj Patel: On eng: need sample payloads, expected p95 latencies, and peak qps. Any idea on typical prompt sizes?
Alex Chen: Vega sent a sample file: median ~15 tokens, but they have long-document cases up to ~1k tokens. We should plan batching + KV cache config.
Sarah (CS): Proposed success criteria: 1) E2E p95 latency <400ms for their 90% traffic on Dedicated small; 2) CI integration passing with redwood-sdk; 3) Runbook + rollback steps delivered. Additions?
Mike S.: Add ops enablement: 30-45m training session and a renewal-signal checklist at day 60.
Raj Patel: Also flagging a renewal risk: seasonal traffic could cause capacity mismatch. Recommend auto-burst and usage forecasting syncs.
Sarah (CS): Risk logged: "Seasonal throughput mismatch". Mitigation: enable burst capacity, weekly usage check-ins for first 90 days.
OnboardBot: Reminder: complete onboarding intake form https://redwood.internal/onboard/forms/vega (48h)
Alex Chen: Drafting runbook skeleton — checklist items:
- API key / prod provisioning steps
- Canary rollout example (traffic split)
- Dashboards: latency, token usage, error rates
- Escalation contacts + SLO thresholds
Raj Patel: I'll create a small benchmark template and give burst config suggestions. Might be ready by day 4.
Sarah (CS): Can we aim for an integration demo Tue (day 3)? Mike available?
Mike S.: Yes, Tue 10am PT works. I'll bring integration checklist.
Raj Patel: I'll try to get a benchmark script by then; fallback is day 4.
Sarah (CS): Action items:
- Sarah: Check legal sign-off ETA, request prod key provisioning (due day 2)
- Mike S.: Integration checklist + demo (due day 3)
- Alex: Runbook + training slides (due day 7)
- Raj: Benchmark + burst config (due day 5)
- Vega (Jenna/Omar/Luis): sample payloads, SSO info, compliance docs (due day 2)
Mike S.: Also adding a prompt-preservation test to catch tokenization regressions.
Alex Chen: Suggest standing agenda for twice-weekly 30m sync: blockers, telemetry, rollout decision.
Raj Patel: Add acceptance criterion: no major quality regression post-rollout per Vega's rubric (precision@k).
Sarah (CS): I'll schedule "Onboard Health" 30-min sync twice weekly for first 4 weeks and invite stakeholders.
OnboardBot: Meeting created: VegaCo Onboarding  Tue 10:00 PT, 30m. Invites sent.
Sarah (CS): I'll post the onboarding doc here after intake is complete. Thanks everyone :handshake:
